material.head: Broke down from a 5-week base
material.text: It closed below the base's bottom on 2.6x average volume. The break session closed 0.3 ATR past the line on a 0.9-ATR range.

material.head: Weekly chart: advancing
material.text: Price is above a rising 30-week average: the advancing stage.
material.learn: Stocks cycle through basing, advancing, topping and declining; longs pay in the advancing stage.

material.head: A bull flag
material.text: It ran +27% in 15 sessions, then drifted for 17 sessions on lighter volume, giving back 15% of the run: a pause that often precedes the next leg.
material.learn: A sharp move (the pole), then a shallow drift on light volume (the flag); the next leg often matches much of the pole.

material.head: Resistance +1.2% above
material.text: The nearest ceiling is +1.2% above (0.8 ATR), where 3 levels (3 kinds) meet: the most-traded price of six months, the 50% retracement of the May 27–Sep 16 drop and the 20-day average: little room before sellers have stepped in before.
material.learn: A ceiling: sellers stepped in there before.

against.head: Confirmed double top
against.text: It topped twice at one level (Sep 11 and Oct 30) and has closed below the low between them: a confirmed double top. 2 of the 3 closes from the break on held below the level it broke, and the break session closed 1.2 ATR past it on a 2.9-ATR range: a stretched spike.
against.learn: Two highs at one price with a low between; the pattern counts once price closes under that low.
